title: DFT study of atmospheric characteristics of CF3SO2F: the fungibility of the insulation gas of SF6
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7410-7420
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04357C, Paper
Open Access

Wei Liu, Yuanyuan Zheng, Yuanyuan Cui, Dan Li, Qinqin Yuan, Kun Wang, Longjiu Cheng
The possible dissociation of SF3SO2F under atmospheric conditions (·OH) is simulated by Car–Parrinello molecular dynamics (CPMD), and its global warming potential (GWP) value is evaluated by theoretical calculations.
